tasks.subject: Task 1: Narrow getAllColors to list-page columns and introduce ColorListItem
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Reduce the `getAllColors` payload below the Next.js 2 MB fetch-cache limit so the "Failed to set fetch cache" warning stops, while keeping the `/colors` page rendering exactly as before.

**Files:**
- Modify: `app/colors/utils/colorDataService.ts`
- Modify: `app/colors/page.tsx`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- ColorListItem interface exported with slug/color_name/hex_code/emotional_associations
- getAllColors returns Promise<ColorListItem[]> with select("color_name, hex_code, emotional_associations")
- ensureArray still applied to emotional_associations
- getColorBySlug, getAllColorSlugs, getAllColorNames, ColorInfo unchanged
- page.tsx reads color.color_name/hex_code/emotional_associations (flat shape)
- npx tsc --noEmit exits 0
- pnpm lint exits 0 with no new warnings
- grep -c 'Failed to set fetch cache' /tmp/nextdev.log returns 0 after visiting /colors

**Verify:** `npx tsc --noEmit && pnpm lint && : > /tmp/nextdev.log && curl -s -o /dev/null http://localhost:3000/colors && test "$(grep -c 'Failed to set fetch cache' /tmp/nextdev.log)" = '0'`
